maxWCU.description:
Max number of write capacity units to scale to. While auto scaling this will be the maximum number that we will ever
scale to

maxRCU.description:
Max number of read capacity units to scale to. While auto scaling this will be the maximum number that we will ever
scale to

defaultWCU.description:
Default write capacity unit for every dynamo db table. When auto scaling this will be the minimum number that we will
ever scale down to

defaultRCU.description:
Default read capacity unit for every dynamo db table. When auto scaling this will be the minimum number that we will
ever scale down to

period.description:
Number of minutes to monitor the cloud watch metrics to check for throttled throughput and consumed capacity before making any scaling decisions.
Once the dynamo db table has auto scaled, this will also be the number of minutes before we consider this table
for the next round of auto scaling

enabled.description: Whether dynamo db autoscaling is enabled or not

frequency.description:
Frequency in minutes at which auto scaling thread should wake up to check for auto scaling. Default 30 minutes
since we want to auto scale as less frequently as possible due to AWS limitation on the number of times we
auto scale down

name: DynamoDBAutoScalingSpec
